description:

Thank you for letting us know. They system doesn't have a lot of
functionality at the moment. So, we cannot cancel your booking or refund

For the time being, students do not need to sign up for classes. Please
feel free to attend any class you wish and keep track of how many you
attend. We have handy punch cards at the studio to help you keep track.

Be well,
Elizabeth

title: Reservation Reminder for East Potomac Golf Links - BLUE Course
description: 96 Confirmation# 429285454 Hi Esther Scott , Your reservation is tomorrow at 5:10 pm. East Potomac Golf Links - BLUE Course Sunday, September 6, 2026 5:10 pm 4 Player(s) A Note from National Links Trust: We are devastated to share that the Trump administration has terminated National Links Trust’s lease, effective immediately. In the short term, NLT has agreed to stay on as operators, allowing our courses to remain open and our hundreds of dedicated employees to stay in place. However, the future of affordable, accessible, high-quality public golf in the District is bleak. This is not the update we wanted to share. As a DC golfer, you know how special the East Potomac, Langston, and Rock Creek courses are. While this termination is a major setback, we remain stubbornly hopeful that a path forward can be found that preserves affordable and accessible public golf in the nation’s capital for generations to come. PlayDCgolf and NLT remain fully committed to honoring the legacies and principles of DC’s historic public courses. We hope that you stand with us and continue to share your love of DC public golf with friends, family, and beyond. Tee Time Cancellation Policy: Please log into the tee time booking portal at least 2 hours in advance to cancel or reduce the number of players to your tee time. Questions about your reservation? Our students have jumped right in, getting to know their teachers and classmates, learning new routines, and settling into the rhythm of the school day.
